title: Inde Navarrette & Gracie Abrams on ‘SNL’ Halloween Episode: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free
summary: Livestream the Obsession actress and pop singer/songwriter on Saturday, Oct. 31 — watch live online for free.

On Saturday (Oct. 31), Saturday Night Live returns with the fourth episode of season 52. The sketch comedy show taps Obsession -star Inde Navarrette to host the Halloween episode, while singer/songwriter Gracie Abrams serves as musical guest .

SNL airs live on Saturday (Oct. 31), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?

In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC.

Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?

SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past include Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Meryl Streep, Harry Styles and others.
